android.desc:
Quit smoking with Flamy

Ready to quit smoking or vaping and build a healthier routine? Flamy combines a personal quit plan, cigarette counter, progress tracker, and practical craving support in one place.

CHOOSE YOUR QUIT METHOD

Pick the approach that fits your situation:

- Set a quit date and stop on Day X.
- Taper gradually with a personal reduction plan.
- Track nicotine replacement products as part of your strategy.

TRACK PROGRESS THAT MATTERS

The Flamy quit smoking tracker shows:

- time since quitting
- cigarettes avoided
- money saved and personal savings goals
- health and quit milestones
- achievements, streaks, and motivating statistics

CRAVING SOS

Log cravings and slips honestly. SOS support gives you quick access to breathing exercises, distractions, motivation, and practical coping strategies. Your entries can also help you recognize recurring situations and personal patterns.

PERSONAL MOTIVATION

Save your reasons for quitting, use tips and motivation cards, celebrate achievements, and set meaningful goals. Games can help distract you during difficult moments. Challenges let you invite friends and encourage one another.

WIDGETS AND WEAR OS

Widgets keep progress, personal reasons, and SOS support on your home screen.

Flamy for Wear OS keeps quit time, savings, cigarettes avoided, and health progress visible on your wrist. The Flamy Tile shows your progress at a glance. Complications place quit time, savings, and your next health milestone on the watch face. Set up Flamy on your phone first, then open both apps to sync.

IMPORTANT

Flamy supports self-monitoring and motivation. It does not provide a medical diagnosis and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Discuss nicotine replacement products or health concerns with a doctor or pharmacist.

Start today and quit smoking step by step with Flamy.

Support: support@flamy.co
Privacy Policy: https://flamy.co/privacy
